items.headline: US stocks rise near their record after the latest jobs report eases worries about inflation
items.summary: U.S. stocks moved near record levels after a jobs report eased inflation concerns, while Nvidia and other AI-linked shares supported the market.

items.headline: Nvidia is selling a fix for rogue AI agents
items.summary: Nvidia introduced the Open Agent Safety Platform, including software access controls and a hardware watchdog running on BlueField chips. Anthropic, Salesforce and JPMorgan are among organizations collaborating on the open-source safety effort.

items.headline: Wall Street just launched an ETF for large language models. Here’s what’s inside
items.summary: Global X launched the LLMA ETF, which holds Meta, SpaceX and Alphabet among its largest positions and has no direct ownership of OpenAI or Anthropic because they remain private. The article highlights the fund’s concentration and exposure to Hong Kong-listed AI companies.
